summary: Build bank-ready sustainability disclosures with IFRS S1 and S2. Learn practical tools for materiality, controls, and reporting.
lede: Sustainability disclosure for banks organizes material climate and sustainability information into decision-useful reporting tied to governance and risk. It is designed for sustainability, finance, risk and credit professionals who need to prepare evidence-backed reports, and covers applying IFRS S1 and IFRS S2, assessing materiality, linking disclosures to risk ownership, and establishing data controls.
audienceIntro: This sustainability disclosure for banks and financial institutions course is built for professionals who must turn climate and sustainability information into bank-ready reporting, governance materials, and assurance-supporting evidence.
outcomes: IFRS S1 And S2 Gap Analysis
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites include working knowledge of banking operations, financial reporting, or risk management; familiarity with ESG terminology; and basic experience with internal reporting workflows. No programming is required, although the course uses digital disclosure templates, spreadsheet-based data checks, and scenario exercises based on IFRS S1 and IFRS S2. Advanced topics are taught at operational application level, with clear guidance on how to scope disclosure work, coordinate data owners, and prepare reporting packs for review.
